title: Oshkosh Corporation: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:MECHANICAL:LINKAGES AND CA (44 affected)
summary: THE PARKING BRAKE LINKAGE MAY NOT EXERT SUFFICIENT FORCE TO THE PARKING BRAKE SYSTEM TO HOLD THE VEHICLE ON A GRADE.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:ATTACHMENTS (823 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED VEHICLES DO NOT HAVE A PROTECTIVE FUEL TANK SHIELD. AS A RESULT THE 137 INCH AND 161 INCH WHEELBASE CHASSIS CABS FAIL TO CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 301, "FUEL SYSTEM INTEGRITY". IF THE ABOVE VEHICLES UNDERGO FRONTAL IMPACT, THE DRIVE SHAFT FRONT UNIVERSAL JOINT MAY COME INTO CONTACT WITH THE FUEL TANK, RESULTING IN FUEL SPILLAGE.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:ATTACHMENTS (24,400 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED VEHICLES WERE MANUFACTURED WITHOUT THE MIDSHIP FUEL TANK PROTECTIVE SHIELDS. AS A RESULT, THEY DO NOT CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 301, "FUEL SYSTEM INTEGRITY", DUE TO EXCESSIVE FUEL SPILLAGE UPON FRONTAL IMPACT.

title: Ford Motor Company: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:FAN (253,500 affected)
summary: SOME OF THE ENGINE COOLING FANS ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES MAY BE SUBJECT TO HIGH BLADE STRESSES THAT CAN RESULT FROM RESONANT VIBRATION INPUTS OCCURRING DURING NORMAL VEHICLE OPERATION.

title: GRUMMAN FLXIBLE CORP.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:CABLE (1,727 affected)
summary: THE POWER CABLES LEADING FROM THE BATTERIES OF THE INVOLVED VEHICLES ARE SUBJECT TO A CHAFING CONDITION, WHICH, IF UNDETECTED OR NOT CORRECTED CAN CAUSE WEAR TO THE CABLE INSULATION.

title: GRUMMAN FLXIBLE CORP.: STRUCTURE:SHIELDS:PROTECTORS:LINES:TUBING (688 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN VEHICLES, THE DRIVER"S BARRIER GLAZING WAS NOT MARKED AS SAFETY GLAZING MATERIAL. THIS DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 205, "GLAZING MATERIALS".

title: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co.: TIRES:CORD (158 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED TIRES HAVE NARROW, OFF CENTER PLIES AND INCORRECT TURN-UP HEIGHTS. TIRES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 119, "NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES FOR VEHICLES OTHER THAN PASSENGER CARS".

title: GENERAL TIRE & RUBBER CO.: TIRES (215 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED TIRES DO NOT COMPLY WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 109, "NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES", IN REGARD TO THE PLUNGER ENERGY PORTION OF THE STANDARD.

title: Land Rover: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:MASTER CYLINDER:PISTONS:CUPS:SPRI (1,300 affected)
summary: THE POSSIBILITY EXISTS THAT UNDER HIGH AMBIENT/UNDERHOOD TEMPERATURES, A CHEMICAL ACTION MAY TAKE PLACE BETWEEN ANY WATER CONTENT IN THE BRAKE FLUID AND THE BRAKE SPRING IN THE MASTER CYLINDER SECONDARY PISTON CHAMBER. AS A RESULT OF THIS CHEMICAL ACTION, A GAS DEVELOPS (HYDROGEN) WHICH DISPLACES THE BRAKE FLUID CAUSING A PROGRESSIVE INCREASE IN BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER PISTON TRAVEL WITH SUBSEQUENT DECREASE IN THE EFFICIENCY OF THE REAR BRAKING SYSTEM.

title: UNIROYAL GOODRICH TIRE CO: TIRES:TEMPORARY (T-TIRE) (3,550 affected)
summary: SOME OF THE INVOLVED TIRES DO NOT MEET THE MINIMUM ENDURANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 109, "NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES". THIS REDUCED ENDURANCE CAPACITY COULD RESULT IN TREAD SEPARATION IF THE SPARE TIRE IS USED.

title: GENERAL TIRE & RUBBER CO.: TIRES:CORD (343 affected)
summary: TIRES WERE SHOWN TO BE SUBJECT TO SIDEWALL SEPARATION WHEN TESTED FOR PERFORMANCE BY THE MANUFACTURER.

title: General Motors, LLC: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT SPINDLE:KNUCKLE:STEER (85,325 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN VEHICLES, THE LOWER CONTROL ARM BALL JOINT TO STEERING KNUCKLE ATTACHING NUT MAY NOT HAVE BEEN TORQUED TO SPECIFICATIONS. THIS CONDITION COULD CAUSE THE NUT TO BACK OFF, RESULTING IN JOINT SEPARATION.

title: KEYSTONE, INC.: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:ATTACHMENTS (28,000 affected)
summary: THE 22-INCH DIAMETER TANK USED TO SUPPLY FUEL TO THE REFRIGERATION EQUIPMENT IS MOUNTED TO THE TRAILER WITH HARDWARE THAT MAY CRACK OR FRACTURE UNDER STRESS. A CRACK OR FRACTURE IN THE HARDWARE COULD RESULT IN PARTIAL OR TOTAL SEPARATION OF THE TANK FROM THE TRAILER.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDSHIELD (44,900 affected)
summary: A NUMBER OF VEHICLES MAY NOT BE IN COMPLIANCE WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 212, "WINDSHIELD MOUNTING", AS A RESULT OF IMPROPER SEAL CLEANING OR ADHESIVE MISAPPLICATION.

title: APPLIED POWER, INC.: EQUIPMENT:ELECTRIC EQUIPMENT:BATTERY CHARGE (35,000 affected)
summary: AN ADHESIVE CLIP WHICH HOLDS THE WIRE BUNDLE WITHIN THE CHARGER TO THE INTERIOR OF THE CHARGER COULD FAIL. UNDER CONDITIONS OF EXTREME USE, A SHORT BETWEEN THE PRIMARY AND SECONDARY CIRCUITS OF THE CHARGER COULD RESULT.

title: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co.: TIRES:MARKINGS (264 affected)
summary: TUBE-TYPE TIRES WERE INCORRECTLY STAMPED AS TUBELESS. SHOULD THESE TIRES BE PLACED IN OPERATION, SEPARATION IN THE TREAD AREA AS WELL AS BULGING MAY OCCUR. CONTINUED USE MAY CAUSE THE PLY CORDS TO BREAK, CAUSING A LOSS AIR.

title: Carrier Corporation: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE (40 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED VEHICLES HAVE "COMMAND KITS" WHICH AUTOMATICALLY SET THE PARKING BRAKES DURING REFUSE LOADING. IF POWER IS LOST DUE TO A BLOWN FUSE OR THE IGNITION SWITCH IS TURNED OFF, THE PARKING BRAKES WOULD BE RELEASED.

title: PEUGEOT, INC.: AIR CONDITIONER:ELECTRONIC CLIMATE CONTROL MODULE (10,000 affected)
summary: THE AIR CONDITIONING UNITS ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN FILLED WITH AN UNECESSARILY LONG LENGTH OF WIRE FROM THE BLOWER SPEED CONTROL RESISTORS TO THE EVAPORATOR BLOWER MOTOR. DUE TO THE LENGTH OF THE WIRE, CHAFING OR PINCHING MAY OCCUR AT SOME POINT, CAUSING A SHORT CIRCUIT. THIS WILL STOP THE MOTOR.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (39,382 affected)
summary: MOISTURE PRESENT IN THE EXHAUST GAS RECIRCULATION SYSTEM MAY, UNDER CONDITIONS OF SUB-ZERO TEMPERATURES AND LOW EGR FLOW RATE, CONDENSE AND FREEZE IN THE THROTTLE CHAMBER. AN ICING CONDITION COULD OCCUR IF THE VEHICLE OWNER FAILS TO ADEQUATELY WARM UP THE ENGINE BEFORE DRIVING. THIS COULD PREVENT THE THROTTLE FROM CLOSING COMPLETELY AND WOULD RESULT IN HIGHER THAN NORMAN IDLE RPM.
